history.summary: A 1994 99yr 3BR in D05 West Coast at $1.59M / $1304 PSF — 32 years old with ~67 years lease remaining, no MRT proximity listed and no URA data. The low PSF reflects age and lease decay rather than value; an early-90s leasehold with no MRT at the doorstep is a weak investment profile.
history.rating_rationale: At 32 years old with ~67 years of a 99yr lease left, lease decay is now a real drag and the property approaches the >70yr-old / financing-sensitivity zone within the hold. No MRT distance listed (West Coast is car-dependent in parts), no URA appreciation/txn data, and the lowest-tier score 332/1000 with a 231-275 losing arena record. The $1304 PSF is cheap because of age, not because it is underpriced relative to quality. Better D05 leasehold options exist.
red_flags: 1994 build (~32yrs), ~67yr lease remaining — lease decay drag over the hold

catalysts: D05 West Coast — One-North/NUS/Science Park employment in the wider district
